name: marilith
lore:
From the waist up, mariliths appear as strikingly beautiful humanoid women, adorned with jewelry and wielding highly decorated weapons in each of their six arms. Below the waist, their bodies transform into the powerful, scaled form of a giant, green serpent, reaching lengths of 20 feet and weighing nearly two tons. These formidable demons are not just creatures of brute strength; they possess cunning intellects and serve as brilliant tacticians within the Abyssal hordes.

Mariliths stand as master strategists of the Abyss, advising demonic nobility and, in some cases, ruling as serpentine demon queens. Their minds are as sharp as the blades they wield, capable of uniting and coordinating the chaotic forces of other demons—a feat almost impossible for any other being. They possess a rare understanding of tactics and warfare, making them invaluable assets in the endless Blood War against the baatezu, where they command legions with cold, calculating efficiency.

Despite their chaotic nature, mariliths value order and discipline within their ranks, suppressing their own instincts to achieve strategic superiority. They are proud of their martial skills and tactical prowess, often collecting weapons from fallen enemies as trophies, a testament to their victories and a grim reminder of their deadly capabilities. A marilith's cherished weapons are more than mere tools; they are symbols of status and power, fiercely guarded and never surrendered lightly.
